Step 3 has two parts: tick the finished entry, then append this plan's deferred items. The closure note I drafted names follow-up work (SMS batching, and the batch size waiting on a `421`), so under the Markers rule each needs its own item and an `→ item:` marker. That makes "nothing deferred" in the step 2 header wrong, so I correct it first. I'd make these edits in order, with no commands in this step. The deferral scan and `git mv` come in step 5.

---

**Message to partner:**

Plan 15 is complete. Step 3 of the completion protocol is done, and I have no questions for you.

- **Ticked:** the first entry of `11-overdue-notices` (one SMTP connection per message) is closed with `→ done 2026-10-30 (plan 15)`.
- **Filed, because your final-review comments were deferrals:**
  - SMS batching, as a `plan`-sized item with `Done when:` (SMS sends in batches, tested). Since you want it next, it will start aging from today. Say so if you'd rather plan it right away.
  - The batch size of 50, as a watch item with `Revisit if:` the mail host rejects a batch with `421 Too many messages`. It does not age.
- **Header correction:** the plan's status header said "nothing deferred". It now says deferred items are in `specs/deferred_items.md`.
- **Date:** I used 2026-10-30 to match the header already written. The environment reports 2026-10-31, so tell me if you want the dates changed.

Next are step 4 (backlog stats and triage) and step 5 (the deferral scan, then retiring the plan). This directory is not a git repository, so the retire commit will need a repo first.
